title: Flight Routing Lab
dek: Gatebound is a reinforcement-learning system I built in Python for getting a passenger to a destination before a deadline when flights can be delayed or cancelled. This page rebuilds its simulator in your browser and runs four booking policies over the same 64 simulated worlds.
summary: With a tight deadline, planning ahead gets 40 of 64 simulated trips to JFK there on time where booking the nonstop gets 0, but 8 fewer arrive at all.
